name: website
//: implicitDependencies on `docs` is what makes affected propagation reach `website` — Nx's project graph doesn't synthesize edges from target-level dependsOn entries, so changes under docs/ or src/**/*.cs (which mark `docs` affected via its inputs) need this explicit edge to also mark `website` affected.

_ingest-docs.//: Copies docs/{tutorials,guides,explanation,reference} into the Starlight content tree. Hand-written docs with frontmatter are passed through; docfx-generated reference files have YAML synthesized from H1 + first paragraph. Depends on docs:build so the reference is on disk first.

_lint-docs.//: Validates ingested frontmatter against Flowthru's contract (title + description, both non-empty) before Astro is invoked. Errors are mapped back to the source path under docs/.
